fr_html: Mr. ROOT proposera de nouveau, lorsque la discussion de l'article sera reprise, l'adoption de la rédaction de 1907.
en_html: Mr. ROOT said that he would again propose the adoption of the wording of 1907 when the Article was once more brought up for discussion.
